description: IIChart is a native MFC/Win32 chart control that ports Apache ECharts through WebView2. Version 1.0.0.4 supports x86 only and can be deployed through Visual Studio NuGet Package Manager.
releaseNotes: 1.0.0.4 NuGet update. Supports x86 only. x64 support is planned for 1.0.1.0. Free usage includes watermark; paid licence subscription is required to remove watermark.
summary: WebView2 + ECharts chart control for MFC/Win32 native C++ projects.
title: IIChart (Intelligent Industrial Chart Control)
